version: fx-ink 2026-11-12 (designer) — Realm-of-Ink tone pass. Read with fetch('../assets/v2/fx-ink/fx-ink.json'). Paths are relative to assets/v2/fx-ink/

quality.autoLow: switch to low when the 2s rolling avg fps < 40 for 3s (or 1% low < 20); never switch back up during a run. URL ?fx=low forces low

layers.note: v=0 (image top) = press end at dash START, dry split tail at dash END. Stretch along length is safe (bristle streaks run lengthwise)

dissolve.rule: discard if mask < 1 - clamp(opacity*1.18,0,1); alpha *= smoothstep(th, th+0.08, mask)
dissolve.effect: ink dries from the tail back to the press point

slash.geometry: PlaneGeometry(pathR*1.6*widthMul, len) on the ground, y=0.05, rotation (-PI/2, 0, atan2(dx, dz)) so local +Y points from 'to' back to 'from' (press at from)

particles.draw: ONE THREE.Points (custom shader: gl_PointCoord rotated by aRot, frame from aFrame) — 1 draw call for all particles
particles.onGround: y<0.03 -> stop (x/z *0.3), 15% chance to leave a small decal (0.45 m), die within 0.08s

decals.geometry: PlaneGeometry(size,size) y=0.025, rotation (-PI/2,0,random), renderOrder 1 (above ground, below characters), depthWrite false
decals.pool: oldest decal recycled when maxDecals reached

rim.rule: same layout/cell/anchor as the original sheet; just swap the URL. *-rim.png = baked (outline + inner moon rim + haze). *-rimmask.png = RGB mask (R outer line, G inner rim, B haze) for a shader tint if wanted
rim.files: see rim-meta.json (key per atlas action) and route-map.json (original path -> new path)

atmosphere.order: z: #view(0) < fxinkAtmo(2: moonRays, fogInk, fogMist) < #vignette(3) / #sightFog(3) < #ink(4) < #marks(6) < HUD(8). Marks are ALWAYS above fog/rays.

fogInk.scroll: -50% of a 200%-wide layer per 64s (≈16 css px/s at 1024)
fogInk.mask: top 0-30% and bottom 68-100% only (atmo/fog-edge-mask.png or CSS mask-image gradient)

moonRays.place: top-right, 90% of the view, CSS mask radial from top-left
moonRays.blend: normal (pale colour on dark = screen-like, cheaper than mix-blend)

lanternGlow.use: map1 bonfire, map2 gate braziers, map3 seonangdang paper lanterns (초롱)
